name: Fast Finance Pay Corp.
summary: Fast Finance Pay Corp. specializes in providing an extensive range of financial technology services, encompassing merchant payment processing, electronic banking for individual consumers, and swift money transfer options that support numerous international currencies. Their platform's core features include bank accounts equipped with International Bank Account Numbers (IBANs), the provision of debit cards, robust multi-currency transaction capabilities, and the facilitation of both SEPA and SWIFT interbank transfers, alongside services for automated recurring payments. This Berlin, Germany-based firm, which operates as an affiliate of Fast Finance 24 Holding AG, was formerly known as Standard Vape Corporation.
